assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the two reviewed items curated on tomozaki:nakamura-shuji@light-novel at basis_commit, each read in full: #bounded-character-dossier, the canonical B-scope Nakamura Shuji bounded character dossier (INDEPENDENT_BOUNDED_LITERARY_SCOPE_PASS, maturity BOUNDED_INDIVIDUAL_LITERARY_ROLE) over the locked Japanese main V01-V12 with story-locally routed V06.5/V08.5, whose local routes NS-E01 to NS-E11 mix fresh primary returns (V01, V06.5, V07, V08, V11, V12) with inherited analytical routes (V02, V03, V04, V09, V10); and #bounded-reconstruction-model, the canonical derived-use model TOMOZAKI_NAKAMURA_B04_MODEL_V1, marked do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority, which derives from the dossier and is not used as literary evidence. The project's current-state entrypoint and the models README were read for method and gate state only. The supporting character implementation review, evidence manifests, six-pilot integration review, review packet, readings and ledgers are not curated on this subject and are not evidence here. Fumiya's expert evaluations and inner jokes are the focalizer's; Yuzu's V06.5 private fear is her focalization, not Nakamura's knowledge. No adaptation, performed voice, reception or post-V12 material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's directional-standing selectors: NS01_OPPONENT and NS01_YUZU_CARE (V01), NS02_ACK and NS03_CAMP (V02-V03), NS04_RELATION_START (V04), NS65_BIRTHDAY (V06.5 story-local concurrent placement), NS07_FRIEND_HOST (V07), NS08_ROUTE_RETRIEVAL (V08), NS09_10_PRACTICAL_PEERS (V09-V10), NS11_REFUSAL (V11) and NS12_LOCAL_PARTICIPATION (V12). V05 has no dossier band and V08.5 is a review-limit cell, neither of which establishes absence; the V11-V12 interval is off-page; each selector carries only the information shown available to him; nothing after V12 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Dossier section 1 offers a central account, seriousness defended through a rough social interface, as an explicit INTERPRETIVE HYPOTHESIS tested against six rival readings (section 10); the model operationalizes it as the distinction between the end he protects and the means he uses (SM1-SM6). His ends are partly attested by his own stated reasons: the V07 shared-history account of Yuzu (NS-E06) and the V11 explicit protest that Yuzu is being made to blame herself (NS-E10). B is rejected because the model states the considerations compete with no stable priority ranking, the dossier says his limited focalization limits what it can certify, and it declines a complete self-worth system. D is rejected because, unlike a participation-only account, the ends are anchored in his own located reason-giving and tested against counterevidence.

Dossier section 2 gives a ten-row band table V01-V12 with a required limit per band, and the model's selectors forbid a defeat-to-redemption switch because V01 already contains care alongside antagonism (NS-E01). B is rejected because the V02, V03, V04, V09 and V10 bands rest on inherited analytical routes rather than fresh primary returns, V05 has no band, V08.5 is a review-limit cell, and the V11-to-V12 change is explicitly left unshown (section 8). D is rejected because the bands are explicit, chronologically controlled and carry negative transfer limits.

The discovery row does not claim SPEECH. The dossier analyses acts, not wording, and quotes almost nothing; the model characterizes register only by adjectives (plain, direct, rough, joking, tersely caring) and states that no dependable idiolect, fixed insult vocabulary or particle distribution is established and that no freeform Japanese is produced. D is rejected because no recipient-specific register analysis or attested sample is given beyond communicative acts. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence does characterize the register and locates its communicative acts (V07 calibrated joke, V11 refusal).

Dossier section 5 gives ordinary life its own place: the V07 festival hosting and introductions on a fresh primary window (part0023 P178-225), birthday-message work and joking company, and the model lists matches, rematches, entertaining visitors and remembering a relationship's time as positive ordinary ends. C is rejected because only one fresh ordinary-life window exists, the others are inherited routes, and home life, routines and tastes are absent. E is rejected because ordinary conduct is located in a dedicated section with a primary window rather than only as plot function.

Dossier section 9 tabulates seven recipient or role rows (Fumiya as opponent and as friend, Yuzu, Mizusawa, new visitors, Hinami and the group demand, family and education) each with a limit, and the model selects a directional standing before inference (an opponent is not automatically a confidant). B is rejected because most rows rest on one or two episodes, the Yuzu row explicitly lacks a reciprocal protocol, and the Mizusawa row rests on inherited routes. D is rejected because recipient variation is explicit, tested and bounded.

He has no focalized access: the dossier states his limited focalization limits what it can certify, and the V06.5 private scene is Yuzu's interior, not his (NS-E05). His inner life is reached only through located explicit reasons (V07, V11) and the dossier's inference that being taken seriously matters to him. C is rejected because no private state is directly rendered. E is rejected because his own stated reasons in two scenes give more than acts without reasoning.

Conflict is attested across distinct episodes: excuse-making, practice and renewed challenge after defeat (V01 part0034 P80-100, P225-311, fresh), the V03 privacy demand (inherited), and the V11 refusal and departure with explicit reasons while denying that the friendship has ended (V11 p-0016 P164-222, fresh); the model's SM4 separates friendship from requested cooperation. B is rejected because the model gives no general anger threshold or proportionality, states that how new conflicts resolve is not fixed, and records that his manner imposes costs it does not resolve. D is rejected because two conflict modes rest on fresh primary windows with explicit limits.

The V11 refusal is a value-laden decision with stated reasons (treatment, ignored contact, Yuzu's self-blame) and an explicit distinction between friendship and cooperation (NS-E10). The fairness weighing in dossier section 7 is the dossier's own VALUE JUDGMENT, which it says must not be read as healthy boundaries or as cruel abandonment, and he acts without the reader's family knowledge. C is rejected because one scene of reason-giving is not shown deliberation, and the model disclaims a universal right or general stopping policy. E is rejected because explicit reason-giving in a moral conflict is located.

The V07 calibrated joke that relaxes nervous visitors is on a fresh primary window (part0023 P178-225); joking with Fumiya and teasing Mizusawa rest on inherited routes, and the model lists joking company as an ordinary end. C is rejected because no humor style or repertoire is analysed beyond one primary scene. E is rejected because a located primary scene shows his humor functioning socially.

Dossier section 12 records fresh guarded Japanese windows for V01, V06.5, V07, V08, V11 and V12, while V02, V03 (section 10 freshly re-read but no new camp reread), V04, V09 and V10 are inherited analytical routes, V05 has no band and V08.5 is a review-limit cell. The dossier states it is not an exhaustive appearance concordance or a mature-monograph role. C is rejected because about half the bands rest on inherited routes. E is rejected because six volumes have fresh primary returns with paragraph locators.

Affirmative limits are located: the V03 privacy demand and V11 refusal as positive stopping evidence (section 9 and model Stopping), the V08 family route reported as a parental condition and connections rather than company ownership or guaranteed work (part0014 P223-226), Hinami's apology hypothesis as hers, not his motive (section 8), and six rival readings rejected with countercases (section 10). B is rejected because each limit rests on a single scene and the model states the local refusals do not give a general stopping policy. D is rejected because the stopping and route limits are explicit and primary-located.

The band table, the V06.5 concurrent placement, and knowledge clocks (Yuzu's private fear is reader access; Hinami's family history is not his; V12 participation does not reach back to V03) are explicit, and each model selector names what may not be imported. B is rejected because V05 and V08.5 are unknown cells, five bands are inherited, and the V11-V12 interval is unshown. D is rejected because era and knowledge controls are explicit for each selector.

scenario_readiness.note: The model describes communicative acts only, generates no freeform Japanese, and states that no idiolect is established; register is adjectival. CONDITIONAL would treat a rough-register adjective as a speech recipe. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence explicitly bounds voice.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A single selector from NS01_OPPONENT to NS12_LOCAL_PARTICIPATION within Japanese V01-V12, with V06.5 at its story-local concurrent placement; V05 and V08.5 are unknown cells and nothing after V12 is established.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their selector-specific standing: Fumiya as opponent or as friend, Yuzu, Mizusawa, festival visitors, the V11 group and Hinami, and his family-route report.
setting_constraints: Familiar school, gaming, festival, camp and V12 delivery and event settings of the Japanese light novels
No adult employment, marriage, parenting, legal decisions, unseen household disputes or clinical explanations
Yuzu's private V06.5 fear and Hinami's family history are not actor knowledge
Materially novel contexts end in abstention or a returned range

scenario_readiness.note: The model's confidence is firmer only for represented competition, familiar rough advice, particular Yuzu care and specified perceived-unfair demands, and weaker when known history, audience or demanded labor changes, which is what makes a context materially novel; it says some plausible new acts remain underdetermined. CONDITIONAL would extend episode-bound mechanisms beyond the represented standings. NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

conditions: Only familiar peer company in an attested standing: hosting or easing nervous visitors, joking, rough advice to a friend and gaming rematches, as near analogs of the V07 festival and V01-V02 competition returns.
Recipient, audience and known shared history are supplied; no promise that every guest feels safe and no romantic intent inferred from hosting.
No invented home routine, tastes or family life; behavior is described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: The V07 hosting window and the model's SM1 and SM3 support bounded ordinary peer conduct. READY is rejected because only one fresh ordinary-life window exists and his rough interface has recipient-dependent costs. NOT_READY is rejected because familiar peer company is an admitted, located domain.

One explicit refusal with reasons (V11) and one privacy demand (V03) are located, but the model gives no general stopping policy, anger threshold or proportionality and treats the dossier's fairness weighing as interpretation. CONDITIONAL would generalize one reason-giving scene into a deliberation model. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the refusal is directly evidenced.

Particular care for Yuzu is well located (V01 comfort, V06.5 gift, V07 shared-history account, V11 protest), but the dossier and model state that no private couple protocol, reciprocal reassurance policy or equality is shown, the V06.5 scene exposes a communication gap seen from Yuzu's side, and his acts cannot replace her standpoint. CONDITIONAL would model new couple interaction from retrieved care acts. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the relationship is substantively evidenced.

The only work-related evidence is his V08 report of a family-mediated educational and employment route (part0014 P223-226); the model withholds employer identity, guaranteed outcome and adult management style and excludes adult employment. CONDITIONAL has no enacted work context to bound. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the route is located and explicitly limited.

known_limits.statement: V01 already contains his comfort of Yuzu alongside competitive antagonism and his earlier brusque dismissal of her as a practice partner; a defeat-to-redemption chronology is contradicted.
In V01 he improves substantially and still loses to a much stronger opponent; the expert recognition of his execution is Fumiya's situated evaluation, and recognition is not yet friendship.
At the V03 camp the friends arrange information around his pride; his privacy demand is a local boundary, and he is not shown to know or consent to the covert plan.
Yuzu's V06.5 fear of a breakup is her private focalization; the meeting is for a birthday gift, and the gift neither makes her distress imaginary nor shows he knowingly caused it.
The V08 route is his report of a father's acquaintance and an educational threshold; company ownership, a guaranteed job, a chosen vocation and household psychology are not established.

In V11 he refuses further cooperation, citing hurtful treatment and Yuzu's self-blame, while denying that the friendship has ended; he lacks the reader's knowledge of Hinami's family, and the refusal is neither universal law nor abandonment.

V12 delivery and his seat beside Yuzu show changed local participation; the private conversation, any apology, repaired trust and future labor terms are not supplied, and Hinami's apology theory is hers.
The V02, V03, V04, V09 and V10 bands rest on inherited analytical routes without fresh primary returns in this dossier; V05 has no band and V08.5 is a review-limit cell.
No general anger threshold, proportionality rule, priority ordering among competition, Yuzu and friendship, or stopping policy for gaming, partner protection or group obligations is established.
No idiolect, habitual vocabulary, particle distribution or performed voice is established; no freeform Japanese or blind accuracy is validated.
The implementation review, manifests, six-pilot integration review, packet, readings and ledgers to which the dossier and model route are not curated on this subject and were not used.
Nothing after the V12 boundary, and no adult, family-interior, sexual-history or clinical domain, is evidenced.
